_meta.note: English source strings for m6_ui. Change kn.json together with this file (same keys).

app.title: MaatuMitra record check
app.subtitle: Check every red-marked item before you approve.
app.mock_banner: PRACTICE MODE: made-up test data only. No real patient. Do not use this for treatment.
app.not_native: Kannada text in this app is machine-drafted and not checked by a native speaker.
app.bind_refused: Stopped: this app may only run on 127.0.0.1 (this computer).
app.live_banner: LIVE MODE: saving goes to the local server under your own login. Made-up data only; do not use for treatment.
lang.label: Language
role.title: Who are you?
role.hint: Tap a role. This is a practice choice only: no password. In live mode everyone uses their own login.
record.title: Record or upload the conversation
record.mic_label: Tap the microphone to record. Tap again to stop.
record.mock_note: MOCK MODE: your audio is not turned into text. A practice record is used instead.
review.title: Check the record
review.summary_flags: {n} item(s) need your check. They are at the top.
review.summary_clean: The checker found no problem. Read everything and approve only if it is right.
review.legend: Coloured words = where each item was heard. Red with ! and a thick line = a red-marked item.
review.no_record: Pick a record on screen 1 first.
review.verifier_rerun: The checker ran again after your change.
attr.name: Name
reason.title: Why the checker is worried
reason.C1: The words given as proof are not in the conversation.
reason.C2: The value does not match the words that were said.
reason.C3: In this record a 'no' or 'not' may have the opposite meaning (for example 'take' instead of 'do not take').
reason.C4: This dose is outside the usual limits for this medicine.
reason.C5: How often or how many days could not be read clearly.
reason.C6: Something nobody said is in the record, or what the patient said may be wrong.
reason.C7: Speech recognition was unsure about an important word.
reason.C8: The sentence can be read two ways.
reason.none: The checker gave no result. You must check everything yourself.
reason.no_verdict: No checker result was found for this record.
play.no_timing: No timing available for this part.
play.mock_note: MOCK: a test tone, not real speech.
resolve.edit_hint: Type the right value. The checker will look at it again.
approve.blocked: Approve is locked: check {n} more item(s) first.
approve.ready: All red-marked items are answered. The server may still refuse to save.
approve.never_auto: Nothing is saved until you press Approve.
gate.code.refused_unresolved_flags: The checker still shows a problem in this record, so the server does not save it. Correct the data, or ask a doctor.
gate.code.refused_forced: Test setting: the practice server was told to refuse.
gate.code.refused_auth: The server did not accept your login.
gate.code.error_network: Could not reach the server. Nothing was saved.
gate.code.error_other: The server had an error. Nothing was saved.
demo.title: Practice settings (mock only)
demo.force_refuse: Make the practice server refuse the next save
help.title: Advice cards
help.placeholder: The advice helper is not built yet. These are practice cards only.
help.not_sure: Not sure / my question is not here
help.ask_doctor_body: This helper cannot answer this. Ask a doctor or nurse. Do not guess a medicine or a dose.
help.card_status_machine: Machine-drafted text, not checked by a native Kannada speaker.
help.card_status_verbatim: Copied word for word from the source.
help.not_clinician: NO doctor has checked this yet. Do not take it as a doctor's advice.
help.clinician: A doctor has checked this card.
help.voice_note: Voice questions need the advice helper, which is not built yet.
fail.title: Where the checks failed
fail.intro: Real cases where the safety checks missed planted mistakes, from test results. Do not trust a green badge blindly.
fail.blind_spot: Known blind spot: if speech recognition drops a 'no' or 'not' (ಇಲ್ಲ, ಬೇಡ), text-only checks cannot see it.
font.title: Kannada letter test
font.intro: Each line should show joined letters, with no dotted circles and no loose halant marks.
font.note: Automatic tests only check the text and the font file. Look at this page on every phone you use.
resolve.invalid: This value is not allowed. Nothing was changed.
gate.code.refused_stale: The checker result is out of date. Open the record again. Nothing was saved.
gate.code.refused_not_reverified: The changed record still has a problem, or was not checked again. Nothing was saved.
gate.code.refused_unacceptable: The server did not accept the checker result. Nothing was saved.
gate.code.refused_conflict: The record may already be saved or has changed. Open the page again.
gate.code.refused_bad_request: The answers that were sent are not valid. Nothing was saved.
gate.code.refused_forbidden: Only a doctor can save. Nothing was saved.
gate.code.not_found: The server does not know this record, or you may not see it.
login.title: Log in
login.hint: Use your own user id. Your role comes from the server; it cannot be picked here.
login.role_unsupported: This app has no screen for this role.
approve.physician_only: Only a doctor can approve and save. You can only look.
approve.saved_locked: This record is saved. It can no longer be changed here.
record.live_no_patients: The server showed you no patients.
review.load_failed: Could not open this record from the server.
review.bidi_found: This record has hidden characters that change the text direction. They are shown as [U+XXXX]. Read the numbers with care.
resolve.bidi: This value has a hidden direction character. Nothing was changed.
demo.locked: Refusal is switched on by the environment setting; it cannot be switched off here.
error.load_transcript: Could not load the conversation text.
reason.cannot_verify_note: The checker COULD NOT check this. That does not mean it is right; check it yourself.
reason.code.out_of_range: This dose is outside the usual limits for this medicine.
reason.code.exceeds_max_daily: The total dose per day is above the maximum for this medicine.
reason.code.unit_not_allowed: This unit does not fit this medicine.
reason.code.route: Giving this medicine this way (by mouth or by injection) does not fit.
reason.code.cannot_verify: The checker could not check this dose.
reason.code.cannot_verify_paediatric: Child dose: the checker only knows adult limits. A doctor must check a child's dose.
reason.code.cannot_verify_no_range: There is no limit listed for this medicine. Check the dose yourself.
reason.code.cannot_verify_not_in_lexicon: This medicine is not in the checker's list. Check the name and dose yourself.
reason.code.cannot_verify_liquid_strengt: Liquid medicine: the strength (for example 120 mg / 5 ml) is not known, so a dose in ml cannot be checked.
reason.code.cannot_verify_count_unit: A number of tablets or capsules is given but not the strength (mg) of one, so the dose cannot be checked.
v2.read_only: These details cannot be edited here; read and check them.
review.saved_readonly: Saved, read-only. This record is already saved. You can look at it but not change it.
review.resolutions_title: Answers the doctor gave when saving
review.no_stored_verdict: No checker result is stored for this record.
